items.assertion_boundary: Exact surface occurrence is not proof of concept-sense continuity or normative role.
First appearance, disappearance, replacement, influence, and historical superlatives are disabled.
Only controlled subject or assessment-subject entries with facet_eligible=true may enter the subject facet; curriculum courses remain separately identified course entities.

OCR text can enter concept observations only from exact source-bound display-accepted pages; citation-false pages remain nonsemantic candidates and cannot influence citation-ready frequency or relations.
Known OCR omissions, foreign-language Unicode anomalies, unresolved glossary row alignment, and exact duplicate aliases are excluded before corpus or concept derivation.
